name: Accounts v2: orgs, org-level keys & default project
objective: Restructure vocky's accounts plane into an explicit user -> org -> project model: the existing `tenants` row becomes the org in product-facing naming (no table rename), signup auto-provisions a `default` org and a `default` project, `projects` gains UNIQUE(tenant_id, name) plus get-or-create-by-name, and credentials become mintable at org level (`project_credentials.tenant_id` NOT NULL, `project_id` nullable) so one `vk_` key works across every project in the org — while today's project-bound keys keep their exact current semantics. Org creation beyond the default, member invites, and roles stay out of scope (deferred).

review.note: All five slices validated together on the current tree: 206 pytest, 61 web tests, migration round-trip, rebuilt-image smoke, lean-CLI bare-venv import, and a 25/25 live end-to-end run. Consolidated nine durable-doc versions plus docs/cli.md and README.md. The retired security guarantee was rewritten rather than reworded, and the docs follow the code rather than the objective's stale 'default org' wording.
